cues.en: Centuries ago, master archers were able to perform incredible feats of archery. These skills have long since been forgotten, but the Danish archer Lars Anderson is trying to reinvent what has been lost. He uses forgotten historical methods and holds all his arrows in the same hand he shoots with. Once, this technique was widespread, and the Syrian artwork shows that the method is at least 5,000 years old. Arab Archery, the most extensive historical book ever made about archery, states...
cues.zh: 几个世纪前，弓箭大师们能完成令人惊叹的射箭绝技。这些技艺早已被遗忘，但丹麦射手 Lars Anderson 正试图重现失传的东西。他采用已被遗忘的历史方法，把所有箭都握在射箭的那只手里。曾经，这种技法广为流传，而叙利亚艺术品表明，这种方法至少有 5000 年历史。《Arab Archery》是有史以来关于射箭最详尽的历史著作，书中写道……

cues.en: This is the best type of shooting and there's nothing beyond it in power or accuracy. Using this technique, Lars has set several speed shooting records and shoots more than twice as fast as his closest competitors. And being able to shoot fast is just one of the benefits of the method. But the big question is, why has it been forgotten today? About 10 years ago, Lars started using a bow. The arrows he carried in a quiver on his back. Surprisingly, the quiver turned out to be useless when it came to moving fast. The back quiver is a Hollywood myth and was not common in the past.
cues.zh:
这是最好的射箭方式，在力量和精度上都无出其右。
使用这种技术，Lars 创下了多项速射纪录，射速是最接近的竞争对手的两倍多。
而能射得快，只是这种方法的好处之一。
但最大的问题是：为什么它今天被遗忘了？
大约 10 年前，Lars 开始使用弓。
他把箭放在背上的箭袋里。
出人意料的是，快速移动时这个箭袋竟毫无用处。
背式箭袋是好莱坞的虚构，过去并不常见。

cues.en: but it is still spread all over the world. Why? Because modern archers do not move. They stand still, firing at a target board, something that was unknown in the past. These archers also started placing the arrow on the left side of the bow, just as archers do in movies. This is probably due to the fact that aiming at a stationary two-dimensional target makes you aim with one eye instead of two. This one-eyed aiming also led to bows with front sights and other technical gadgets, but that's another story. However, placing the arrow left around the bow is not good while you're in motion.
cues.zh: 但它仍然遍布全世界。为什么？因为现代射箭者不移动。他们站着不动，朝靶板射箭，这在过去是没有的。这些射箭者还开始把箭搭在弓的左侧，就像电影里的弓箭手那样。这大概是因为，瞄准静止的二维靶会让你用一只眼而不是两只眼瞄准。这种单眼瞄准也促成了带前准星和其他技术小装置的弓，但那是另一回事。不过，移动时把箭搭在弓左侧并不好。

cues.en: By placing the arrow on the left side, your hand is on the wrong side of the string, so you need several movements before you can actually shoot. From studying old pictures of archers, Lars discovered that some historical archers held their arrows on the right side of the bow. This means that the arrow can be drawn and fired in one single motion, which is both faster and better. And this was not the only problem with archery today. Lars realized that what we thought was historical archery only works well for modern target archery and Hollywood films.
cues.zh: 把箭放在左侧，你的手就会处在弦的错误一侧，因此要经过好几个动作才能真正射出去。通过研究古代弓箭手的老图片，Lars 发现一些历史上的弓箭手把箭搭在弓的右侧。这意味着可以一次动作完成拉弓和放箭，既更快也更好。而这并不是当今射箭的唯一问题。Lars 意识到，我们所以为的历史射箭，只适用于现代靶场射箭和好莱坞电影。

cues.en: If he wanted to learn to shoot like the master archers of old, he would have to unlearn what he had learned and start reading historical manuscripts instead. He would have to find his way back to a time when archery was simpler and more natural. Exactly like throwing a ball. In essence, making archery as simple as possible. It is harder to learn how to shoot this way, but it gives more options and ultimately, it's also more fun. A war archer must have total control over his bow in all situations.
cues.zh: 如果他想像古代神射手那样射箭，就得摒弃已学的东西，转而开始研读历史手稿。他必须找回弓箭更简单、更自然的那个时代。就像扔球一样。本质上，就是让射箭尽可能简单。这样学射箭更难，但选择更多，最终也更有趣。战场弓箭手必须能在任何情况下完全掌控自己的弓。

cues.en: and must be able to handle his bow and arrows in a controlled way under the most varied of circumstances. The old manuscripts told Lars that master archers could shoot the bow with both hands and still hit the target, so he began practicing. It is also described that an archer in motion must be able to hit a blade so that the arrow splits in two parts, like this. Archers could also pick up enemy arrows and shoot them back, or grab arrows while on the move and fire them rapidly.
cues.zh: 并且必须在各种最复杂多变的情况下，都能有控制地使用弓箭。古老手稿告诉 Lars，神射手可以双手射弓仍命中目标，于是他开始练习。手稿还描述，运动中的弓箭手必须能射中刀刃，让箭一分为二，就像这样。弓箭手还能捡起敌人的箭射回去，或在移动中抓箭并快速射出。

cues.en: There are even myths of archers who could grab an enemy's arrow and shoot it back at him. Lars took it a step further and is now able to catch an arrow while jumping and fire it before he hits the ground. Perhaps most importantly, modern slow archery has led people to believe that war archers only shot at long distances. However, Lars found that they could shoot at any distance, even up close. This does require the ability to fire fast though. In the beginning,
cues.zh: 甚至有传说，弓箭手能抓住敌人的箭再射回去。Lars 更进一步，现在能在跳跃时接住箭，并在落地前把它射出去。也许最重要的是，现代慢速射箭让人以为战弓箭手只在远距离射箭。但 Lars 发现，他们能在任何距离射箭，甚至近距离也行。不过这确实需要快速射击的能力。一开始，

cues.en: Archers probably drew arrows from quivers or belts, but since then they started holding the arrows in the bow hand, and later in the draw hand. Taking it to this third level, that of holding arrows in the draw hand, requires immense practice and skill, and only professional archers, hunters, and so on would have had the time for it. When guns started replacing bows, this technique was forgotten, and the only reason Lars is able to do it is because he spent years practicing intensely. The hard part is not learning how to hold the arrows.
cues.zh: 弓箭手最初可能从箭袋或腰带里抽箭，但后来他们开始把箭握在持弓手里，再往后又握在拉弦手里。要练到第三个层次，也就是把箭握在拉弦手中，需要大量练习和技巧，只有职业弓箭手、猎人等才有时间练这个。当枪开始取代弓时，这项技术被遗忘了，Lars 之所以能做到，只是因为他花了多年时间高强度练习。难的部分并不是学会怎么握箭。

cues.en: but learning how to handle them properly, and drawing fire in one single motion, no matter what method is used. It works in all positions, and while in motion, whether rolling, running, or on horseback. It also works with sharp arrows and powerful bows, and while there is no doubt that those war archers of the past were stronger and more fit than Lars's, his arrows still penetrate chainmail armor and the heavy gambazons worn beneath it. It is difficult to compare actual striking power though.
cues.zh: 但关键在于学会正确操控它们，并且无论采用哪种方法，都能一气呵成地完成拉弓和放箭。它在各种姿势下都有效，也适用于移动中——无论是翻滚、奔跑还是骑马。它同样适用于锋利的箭和强弓；虽然毫无疑问，过去的战弓手比 Lars 更强壮、更健壮，但他的箭仍能穿透锁子甲以及下面穿着的厚重软甲。不过，实际杀伤力很难比较。

cues.en: Modern archers use only one hand, but in the past some archers allegedly used both hands to give the arrow more power. Old manuscripts tell us that it was common to hold three arrows in the draw hand at once while keeping more in a belt quiver. We know that some archers held more, and in a way the bow was the ultimate weapon. Who can escape ten arrows fired quickly after another? From old texts, we know that Saracen archers were expected to be able to fire three arrows in 1.5 seconds, and very skilled archers were even faster.
cues.zh: 现代弓箭手只用一只手，但据说过去有些弓箭手会用双手来给箭增加力量。古老手稿告诉我们，拉弦手同时夹三支箭、腰带箭袋里再放更多箭，是很常见的。我们知道有些弓箭手会拿更多箭，某种意义上弓就是终极武器。谁能躲过接连快速射出的十支箭？从古文献中我们得知，撒拉森弓箭手被要求能在1.5秒内射出三支箭，而非常熟练的弓箭手甚至更快。

cues.en: Lars has managed to shoot three arrows in 0.6 seconds. But while speed is important, hitting the target is essential. To test accuracy and speed at the same time, Lars set up an experiment where he shot incoming arrows with arrows of his own. But he took it one step further. In the 1938 movie, The Adventures of Robin Hood, Robin Hood splits an arrow down the middle line. Some consider this the ultimate archery trick. They're wrong.
cues.zh: Lars 成功在 0.6 秒内射出了三支箭。但速度固然重要，命中目标才是关键。为了同时测试精准度和速度，Lars 设计了一个实验：用自己的箭去射迎面飞来的箭。但他又更进了一步。在 1938 年的电影《罗宾汉历险记》中，罗宾汉一箭把一支箭从正中间劈开。有人认为这是射箭的终极绝技。他们错了。

cues.en: The ultimate archery trick is splitting an incoming arrow in two with one of your own. We do not recommend you trying this at home. Thank you for watching.
cues.zh: 终极射箭特技是用自己的箭把飞来的箭劈成两半。我们不建议你在家尝试。感谢观看。
